zh-CN: 新增项目，可创建和重命名项目，并为项目保存独立记忆；普通对话与项目对话互相隔离，项目会话也支持历史备份与恢复。
Android 语音输入改为应用内原生录音，并完善录音启动、取消和资源释放流程。
调整应用主题配色，欢迎页彩虹装饰线会随标题长度变化。
en-US: Added projects with editable names and independent project memory. Project conversations remain separate from regular chats and are included in history backup and restore.
Android voice input now records natively in the app, with improved startup, cancellation and microphone cleanup.
Updated the app palette and made the welcome-page spectrum accent adapt to the title length.

zh-CN: 浅色首页改为纯白，仅保留「想法，从这里开始」。Quovia 字标沿用输入框的彩虹配色。
调整语音识别启动与取消流程，麦克风无响应时可退出并重试。
账号管理新增 DeepSeek 开放平台注册、创建密钥和充值入口。
en-US: A white welcome screen with a single greeting and a spectrum-colored Quovia wordmark.
Microphone startup and cancellation now recover when a speech service does not respond.
Account settings now link to DeepSeek registration, API keys and top-ups.

zh-CN: 应用正式使用 Quovia 品牌名称，并恢复彩虹折线图标。
欢迎页改为更简洁的白色布局，输入框顶部加入细彩虹装饰线。
同步更新 Android 应用名称、网页标题和更新提示。
en-US: The app now uses the Quovia brand name with the restored rainbow mark.
The welcome screen is simplified with a clean white layout and a fine rainbow accent on the composer.
Android labels, the web title, and update prompts now use the same brand.

zh-CN: 支持按住说话，松开后将识别文字填入草稿。Android 优先使用系统语音识别，并显示麦克风授权、录音和转写状态。
重新排列输入框：深度思考、智能搜索和添加附件放在同一行，输入内容后可直接发送。
右上角新增更新记录铃铛，可离线查看各版本的变化。
设置按账户、应用、语音和关于分组，新增个性化入口，内容暂留空。
en-US: Hold to speak and release to add the transcript to your draft. Android uses system speech recognition when available and shows permission, recording and transcription states.
Thinking, search and attachments now share a toolbar. Enter a message to show the send button.
The bell in the top right opens a version history you can read offline.
Settings are grouped into Account, App, Voice and About. Personalization has a space reserved for future settings.

zh-CN: 接入 GitHub Releases，可在启动时或通过设置检查更新。下载时可查看进度、取消或重试，安装前会校验安装包。
en-US: Updates are delivered through GitHub Releases. Check on startup or in Settings, follow download progress, cancel or retry, and verify the package before installation.

zh-CN: 加入 Android 更新器，支持读取版本清单和验证应用签名。
en-US: Added the Android updater with update manifest and app signature checks.

zh-CN: 首个 Android 预览版，可使用个人 DeepSeek API Key 聊天、上传附件并查看本地会话记录。
en-US: First Android preview with personal DeepSeek API keys, chat, attachments and local conversation history.
